svg.font-family: 'Geist Mono', ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace
svg.title: Modern analytics with Azure Databricks
svg.desc: Modern analytics with Azure Databricks. 14 components in 6 groups. Connections: Apps and devices to Event Hubs (events); Business systems to Fabric Data Factory (copy); Event Hubs to Azure Databricks (Spark streaming); Azure Databricks to Bronze (Delta writes); Fabric Data Factory to Bronze (raw batch); Bronze to Silver (clean); Silver to Gold (aggregate); Gold to Databricks SQL warehouse (SQL); Gold to Azure Machine Learning (training data); Gold to OneLake (mirroring); Databricks SQL warehouse to Power BI (DirectQuery); OneLake to Power BI (Direct Lake); Data Lake Storage to Unity Catalog (access policies); Data Lake Storage to Microsoft Purview (scan).

text.tspan: Event Hubs streams and Fabric Data Factory batch loads land in Data Lake Storage, where Databricks refines bronze to gold for SQL, machine learning and Power BI
